_comment: Verified Lao names for SPEC-12 driver cards. Produced by querying Wikidata (SPARQL, items with country=Laos carrying paired en and lo labels) and OpenStreetMap (Overpass, objects tagged name:lo, bridged to venues via name:en). Candidate matches were filtered by coordinate proximity and English-name similarity, then reviewed by hand to remove false positives -- the naive matcher paired venues with their own city entity and paired a museum with a bank. Only entries below survived review.

token_corrections.reason: Chinese for restaurant, appended in Chinese word order. The preceding Lao text is the actual name.
Thai spelling of the Lao word HIM (beside). Same word, wrong script.

Thai-style PHRA cluster. Lao writes PHA. Confirmed against two independent sources on Haw Phra Kaew and Pha That Luang; applied to Wat Phra Bat Tai on the same orthographic grounds. A codepoint-range guard cannot detect this because RO is a valid Lao letter.

verified_names.note: Both sources return exactly the generated value.
